name: Recipe Swiper
description: Tinder-style stack of four recipe cards (cover, story, ingredients, steps) swiped by drag or buttons, with a side-recipe modal and an idle swipe prompt.
contents: Header with eyebrow, title and page dots
Four stacked cards: cover, about, ingredients list, process steps
Skip back, info and next buttons
Side recipe modal with numbered steps
behavior: Top card drags with rotation and flies off when distance or velocity passes a threshold, then cycles to the back
Buttons throw the top card off screen
Swipe hint appears after idle time and resets on interaction
Info button and the How? chip open the side recipe modal
editableByProps: Recipe title, images, servings, time, story, ingredients, steps and side recipe steps
Swipe distance and velocity thresholds, idle prompt delay
All interface labels and aria labels

needsCodeEdit.change: Change number or type of cards
Change which process step shows the How? chip

fixed: Fixed set of four cards in a stack
Root is full width and viewport height
Imports Playfair Display and DM Sans from Google Fonts
Idle timer listens to document mouse, click and touch events and removes them on unmount
